title: Implement all open issues in grouped stacked PRs
larger_intended_outcome: Implement every currently open GitHub issue on current master as coherent dependency-ordered stacked pull requests, preserving landed fixes and closing parent lanes only after their full acceptance and provider-neutral invariants are proven.

parent_acceptance.original_intent: Implement all open issues in grouped, stacked PRs.
parent_acceptance.acceptance_target: Every issue open at task intake is either satisfied by preserved merged evidence or implemented in a dependency-correct PR; child and parent issues close only when their full ordinary-path acceptance is proven.
parent_acceptance.parent_proof_required: Focused issue reproductions, provider-neutral counterexamples, generated-surface parity, workspace-wide validation, exact-head hosted checks, independent review, ordered stack metadata, and a final merged-master replay of the composed operating loop.
parent_acceptance.residual_intent_rule: Each lane keeps #2721 and #2562 open until all child acceptance, cross-owner invariants, and non-local delegation proof are complete.
parent_acceptance.clarification_needed_when: A maintained reproduction contradicts an issue outcome, an issue requires a new authority surface outside its stated boundary, or a lane cannot remain independently reviewable.

non_goals: Do not create a second operating decision, Planning reconciler, proof registry, review ledger, delegation registry, or provider-specific core authority.
Do not encode GitHub, Codex, this repository layout, exact PR counts, or captured command strings as portable package semantics.
Do not reimplement merged #2752/#2754 behavior; retain it as regression and parent-proof evidence.
Do not merge branches or grant the implementation session independent-review authority.

candidate_lanes.title: Make Planning lifecycle composition executable and owner-scoped
candidate_lanes.outcome: Issues #2345, #2590, #2729, and #2765 are satisfied through one composable Planning lifecycle: projected reconcile routes cannot drift, disjoint stale proposals do not block current owners, admitted proof reaches closeout directly, and material external observations refresh stale owner actions without granting completion authority.
candidate_lanes.proof: Workspace/Planning option conformance, synthetic disjoint-owner integration, proof-bearing integration-to-closeout, provider-neutral external-observation currentness, captured dogfood replays, generated parity, focused tests, and workspace-wide validation.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Removes the lifecycle and command-adapter failures that block reliable implementation, integration, and closeout of later lanes.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Independent verifier authority, generic cross-owner enforcement, non-local delegation, and parent closure remain.

candidate_lanes.title: Keep implementation actors outside verifier decision authority
candidate_lanes.outcome: Issue #2725 is satisfied generically and in the repository adapter: shared credentials or marker syntax cannot let an implementer occupy, suppress, satisfy, or fail an independent verifier decision cycle.
candidate_lanes.proof: Generic shared-transport role fixture, repository review-marker admission regression, implementation handoff posture, negative merge-ready and blocked-marker cases, focused tests, and hosted checks.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Restores the protected reviewer boundary required before later enforcement and delegation claims can be trusted.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Lifecycle composition, generic cross-owner enforcement, non-local delegation, and parent closure remain.

candidate_lanes.title: Ratchet generic cross-owner enforcement invariants
candidate_lanes.outcome: Issue #2762 makes target identity, proof admission/publication, bounded external effects, residue disposition, verifier authority, and external-observation currentness release-gating invariants over replaceable synthetic owners rather than repository vocabulary.
candidate_lanes.proof: Provider-neutral composed conformance, negative split-authority mutations, authority-surface inventory delta, no-new-parallel-owner check, direct-work quiet-path measurements, and workspace-wide validation.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Turns the landed and repaired counterexamples into generic impossibility properties required by parent #2562.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Non-local delegation and final parent composed closure remain.

candidate_lanes.title: Prove ordinary non-local delegation through the enforcement kernel
candidate_lanes.outcome: Issue #2763 is satisfied through transport-neutral assignment, dispatch, return admission, integration, proof, and continuation semantics plus one real supported-host dogfood episode, without giving the worker scope or closure authority.
candidate_lanes.proof: Deterministic automatic/manual transport parity, weak/stale/wrong-target returns, no-safe-transport failure, real supported-host dispatch and return, lineage preservation, cost comparison, and direct-local quiet path.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Completes the delegation-specific composed scenario required by #2562.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Final generic composed replay and parent issue closure remain.

candidate_lanes.title: Reconcile landed children and close the remediation parents
candidate_lanes.outcome: Already-landed #2752/#2754 evidence and all new child lanes are reconciled on merged master; the full generic operating loop satisfies #2562 and the dogfooding remediation replay satisfies #2721 without stale continuation.
candidate_lanes.proof: Merged-master issue inventory, parent acceptance matrix, generic cold-start-to-closeout-to-resume scenario, supported-host remediation replay, no stale owner/issue residue, exact hosted checks, and independent review.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Provides parent-level proof and honest tracker closure for every issue open at intake.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: None when parent acceptance and all tracker states are reconciled.

dependency_assumptions: #2762 consumes the repaired lifecycle and verifier boundaries instead of duplicating their owners.
#2763 consumes the #2762 enforcement kernel and merged #2753 target identity contract.
#2562 and #2721 close only after all child lanes land and the composed merged-master replay passes.
Merged PR #2758 remains the implementation authority for #2752 and #2754; the final lane only reconciles proof and tracker state.
parallelization_assumptions: Lifecycle composition and verifier authority are semantically independent, but PRs remain linearly stacked per the user request.
All later lanes are dependency-ordered and must be restacked on the exact predecessor head before review.
proof_expectations: Each promoted lane records failing-before and passing-after fixtures for every issue reproduction and portability counterexample.
Run the routed implement/proof command with exact changed paths and focused tests for each lane.
Run workspace-wide lint, typecheck, tests, generated parity, package-artifact checks, and maintained dogfood replays before handoff.
Inspect exact-head hosted CI, Security, Semver, review threads, and independent reviewer output before any merge-readiness or closure claim.
promotion_rule: Promote one dependency-ready coherent lane at a time; preserve already-landed evidence, keep provider/repo fixtures separate from portable contracts, and stack PRs only where the later lane depends on the prior lane.
notes: Task intake found eleven child/parent issue records plus the remediation parent. #2752 and #2754 already have merged implementation evidence but remain open because their nested stacked PR did not target the default branch; they are preserved as landed behavior and reconciled during parent closure.
